title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Technical Consultant
description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Technical Consultant 
 Company Profile DPAY Consultancy Services Private Limited is an Indian IT and consulting company specializing in ERP solutions, payroll systems, AI automation, software development, and enterprise consulting services. We help organizations streamline operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate digital transformation through innovative technology solutions and expert consulting services. 
 Job Title Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Technical Consultant Industry Information Technology & ERP Consulting Services Job Type Full-Time, Permanent Experience 2+ Years Location India Work Mode Work From Office (WFO) Only 
 Role Overview We are looking for a skilled and motivated Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) Technical Consultant to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and supporting technical solutions within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O environment. You will work closely with functional consultants, project managers, and clients to deliver scalable ERP solutions that align with business requirements. This role requires strong technical expertise in Dynamics 365 F&O development, integrations, customizations, and system support. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and customize solutions in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations. Develop and maintain X++ customizations, extensions, workflows, and reports. Build and support integrations using APIs, Azure services, and third-party applications. Create and maintain SSRS reports, forms, classes, tables, and data entities. Participate in technical design discussions and provide scalable solution recommendations. Collaborate with functional consultants to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Perform code reviews, debugging, testing, and deployment activities. Support data migration, system upgrades, and environment management. Ensure application performance, security, and coding best practices. Provide technical support and troubleshooting for client issues. Prepare technical documentation and maintain development standards. Stay updated with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O technologies and industry best practices. Required Skills & Technical Expertise Strong experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) development. Hands-on expertise in X++ programming . Experience with Visual Studio, Lifecycle Services (LCS), and Azure DevOps . Knowledge of SSRS reporting and Power Platform integrations. Experience with APIs, OData services, and custom integrations . Understanding of ERP implementation lifecycle and business processes. Familiarity with SQL Server and database concepts. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team environment. Good communication and stakeholder management skills. Educational Qualifications Required Qualifications B.Tech / B.E in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. MCA (Master of Computer Applications). Preferred Qualifications Microsoft Dynamics 365 certifications. Experience with Azure Cloud services. Knowledge of Power BI and Power Automate. Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies. Prior experience in ERP implementation projects. What We're Looking For Passion for ERP technologies and enterprise solutions. Strong technical and analytical mindset. Ability to handle multiple projects and deadlines. Client-focused approach with professionalism. Willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies. Perks & Benefits Competitive salary package. Opportunity to work on enterprise-level ERP projects. Career growth and continuous learning opportunities. Exposure to AI automation and modern business technologies. Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment. Flexible and supportive team culture. Professional development and certification support. Employee recognition and performance-based growth opportunities. Work Culture at DPAY Consultancy Services Private Limited At DPAY Consultancy Services Private Limited, we believe in innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We foster a collaborative environment where employees are encouraged to share ideas, grow professionally, and contribute to impactful digital transformation projects across industries.
